title: Omahab release manifest (release.json v1)
description: Metadata for one published Omahab release. The document lives in the release channel directory (default https://github.com/davidgilesgt/omahab/releases/latest/download) next to the artifacts it describes. Chain of trust: a detached minisign signature SHA256SUMS.sig (produced with `minisign -S -m SHA256SUMS -s <key> -t <comment>`, verified with `minisign -Vm SHA256SUMS -P <key from release/minisign.pub> -x SHA256SUMS.sig`) attests SHA256SUMS, and SHA256SUMS attests the sha256 of every artifact including this release.json. The bootstrap (scripts/install) relies only on SHA256SUMS + SHA256SUMS.sig; omahabd update tooling additionally consumes release.json. Catalog substitution: each key of `images` provides the digest for one distinct image repository referenced by deploy/catalog/catalog.json; the hex part after `sha256:` is substituted into the corresponding ${..._DIGEST} variable listed in that key's description. Digests must be real registry digests resolved at release time; placeholder digests are schema-invalid by design.

schemaVersion.description: Release manifest contract version. Bump on any incompatible change and publish a new schema $id.

channel.description: Publication channel this manifest was emitted for.

version.description: Semver 2.0.0 release version; must match the version embedded in artifact names.

sourceDateEpoch.description: SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH used for reproducible artifact builds (Unix seconds, UTC).

publishedAt.description: Publication time, RFC 3339, UTC only (trailing Z enforced by the pattern).

architectures.description: CPU architectures this release provides artifacts for.

name.description: Flat file name inside the release directory; no path components. Must appear in SHA256SUMS with a matching checksum.

kind.description: Artifact role. installer: signed omahab-installer-<version>-<arch> binary executed by scripts/install.

arch.description: Architecture the artifact is specific to; all for architecture-independent files.

images.description: Pinned image digests for the curated platform catalog, one entry per distinct image repository. Every catalog ${..._DIGEST} variable must resolve here; a release with unavailable digests must not be published.

digest.description: Real OCI digest resolved from the registry at release time; all-zero placeholder digests are invalid.
